## Expected economic invariant

Which synthetic reserve, claim or funding rule should hold?

## Reproduction

Command (Python standard library only), synthetic scenario JSON or minimal code, and actual result. Do not include real account, wallet or private data.

## Why this matters

Does this change a research conclusion, hide a funding shortfall, accept a forged event or mislead about actual physical evidence?

## Proposed minimal correction

A concise fix and a focused regression case are preferable to large, redundant test suites.

The model is educational and not a production financial system. Security-relevant reports involving real systems should follow SECURITY.md rather than public reproduction.
